description: Find self-guided Mappu walking tours for a city, neighbourhood or landmark, when the traveler wants a walk or asks what to see on foot. Returns up to five published walks, each with distance, walking and listening minutes, ordered stops with a short teaser, their audio-guide page and coordinates, and a link that opens the walk in Mappu. Covers only walks Mappu has published; a trip plan does not have to follow them.

query.description: City, neighbourhood or landmark to explore on foot, not personal details.

name: mappu_find_walks
title: Find walking tours
